title: I’m Creating a PvPvE Extraction RPG - This is the pyro class. How am I doing?
author: zanemoore575

comments.author: TheBigQuestion354
comments.body:
What is with all these PvPvE extraction games, you are choosing one of the hardest genres to build? Anyways actual feedback:  
Your UI is SUPER AI. It needs work and that's like not hard at all, just need some creativity.  
Your models look Claude made, if so don't do that. Use Tripo or Meshy or whatever.

replies.author: zanemoore575
replies.body: I know it’s ambitious, its just the dream game to me so that’s why I’m building it this way :)

replies.author: zanemoore575
replies.body: Haha trying to make a fun game not one that looks next gen :)

comments.author: newgenesisscion
comments.body:
The movement for the player model is stiff, try making it more fluid/responsive. This is what the player will see the most.

The UI can be refined as well, it's just a wall of text at the moment. 

The graphics and abilities look really good. Always loved Pyromancies.

replies.author: zanemoore575
replies.body: Hey yeah that right hand side window is not Ui it’s testing stuff, but thanks so much for the feedback on the movement. Animations are pretty tough to get feeling right 😅

comments.author: MinimumEffort-Games
comments.body: Def look at some different animations. And it feels very "slow" to me. But thats just my opinion

replies.author: zanemoore575
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback. The games still early - but I’ll definitely think about how I can improve the animations. I want the game to feel intentionally slow and tactical RPG style.

replies.author: MinimumEffort-Games
replies.body: alright, maybe with some nicer animations it will "feel"  abit better even when slow. The idea seems nice.

comments.author: lorekeeper32
comments.body: Looks pretty good so far! With some more polishing, it could be really good.

replies.author: zanemoore575
replies.body: Thank you! Yep, there’s still so much work to do 😅 Especially the map! Thanks for your feedback, it means a lot

replies.author: zanemoore575
replies.body: 🤣🤣 Nice it is a bit like dark and darker - just more classic mmo inspired

replies.author: theflossboss1
replies.body: You are making a more amateur Mistfall Hunters it looks like

comments.author: rrcecil
comments.body: Get rid of those dragons please that UI is crazy
